rows.label: OpenCode Zen
rows.notes: renamed from opencode; per-model routing (claude-*/qwen*-plus -> anthropic-messages, gemini-* -> google-generative-ai) is handled by api_routes (W2), default wire shown here.

rows.label: OpenCode Go
rows.notes: declared base .../zen/go is normalized to .../zen/go/v1 at the wire. pi flags minimax-m3 as openai-completions (W2 fix).

rows.label: GitHub Copilot
rows.notes: renamed from copilot (id only, host kept). upstream key env=GITHUB_TOKEN; pi COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN; voidcode GITHUB_COPILOT_TOKEN kept as fallback. wire_source=provider: the catalog still records upstream truth (claude-* -> anthropic-messages, gpt-5*/grok-4.5/4.6/oswe*/mai-* -> openai-responses) but dispatch stays on our implemented chat-completions wire. OMP's copilot Anthropic route needs a parsed credential envelope, Authorization: Bearer, the Copilot identity headers and a negotiated integration id (pi anthropic.ts:2017-2041,3423); none of that is verifiable without a live Copilot token.

rows.label: Together
rows.notes: host api.together.ai kept (working today); pi declares api.together.xyz.

rows.label: Fireworks
rows.notes: pi does not reference this key in its descriptors, but upstream models.dev DOES carry fireworks-ai (34 models) at .../inference/v1/.

rows.label: OpenRouter
rows.notes: runtime-only (no models.dev key). pi wire=openrouter pseudo-wire; voidcode stays openai-completions.

rows.label: Endpoint

rows.notes: renamed from kimi-coding. KIMI_CODING_API_KEY is deliberately not shared with moonshot: api.kimi.com/coding vs api.moonshot.ai. pi wire/base UNVERIFIED; no OAuth login.
